Aśoka
or azoka paNDita Bud. logician; teacher of Candragomin; q. Dharmottara an. hence flourished after 847 A. D.
--Avayavinirākaraṇa.
--Sāmānyadūṣaṇadikprasāritā.
Both ptd. in Haraprasad Sastri's edn. of Six Bud. Nyāya Tracts. Bib.

.
See also JBORS. XXII. i. App. F. p. XIX.

Aśoka
or azokamuni Jain.
--Dānaśīlatapabhāvanākulaka or Dānādikulakācāra.
. Jainagranthāvalī p. 199. Peters. IV. Extr. p.. 122-23.

Aśokakathā
Jain. Fl. J. II. iv. 27.
See below Aśokacandrakathā an. Aśokacandrarohiṇīkathā.

Aśokakalpa
botany. Q. by Mallinātha on Meghasandeśa, 86.

Aśokakāntāmārīcīsādhana
Bud. Cordier II. p. 387. III. p.. 10. 43. 45. Nepal II. p. 267.
Pt.. Sādhanamālā,

Aśokacandrakathā
Jain. Skt. Firenze 741. Fl. J. II. iii. 1; II. iv. 2.
See below under Aśokaroh2iṇīkathā. [Page433-a.

Aśokatrirātravrata
from Bhaviṣyottarapurāṇa. America 3452. BISM. v.. 363/22.

. PUL. II. p. 160. Rajapur 525. Weber 1194 (7).
--from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa. Hpr.

Aśokadattavyākaraṇa
Bud. AMG. II. p. 217. AR. XX. p. 410. J.. 1927 (Oct.-Dec.) p. 254 (A. datta. vyā.). Kanjur Kyoto 760 (32). Nanjio 23 (22) 42.

Aśokadanta
a. of the copper-plate inscription of King Bhūpendravarmadeva of Kaliṅga, recording the donation of a plot of land. See Epi. Ind. XXIII. p. 266.

Aśokadeśanā
Bud. Hpr. III. p. 5. Nepal II. p. 239.

Aśokapūjana
dh. pūjāvidhi attributed to Vyāsa. Udaipur I.

Aśokamalla
son of King Vīrasiṁha. Q. Kīrtidhara, Abhinavagupta an. a little-known work named Sudhābdhi.
--Nṛtyādhyāya (?)

.
The ms. itself begins an. ends abruptly an. there is no clue to find the name of the bigger work of which this is only a chapter.

Aśokamālikā
name of C. by Rāma Tarkavāgīśa on the Mugdhabodha Vyākaraṇa.

Aśokarājaputracakṣurbhedanidānasūtra
Bud. on the blinding of Kuṇāla, son of Aśoka. Nanjio 1367.

Aśokarohiṇīkathā
Jain. Chani 2785. Fl. J. II. iv. 27.
An Aśokacandrarohiṇīkathā (also called Rohiṇīparvakathā) by Muktivimala is published in Dayāvimala Jaina Granthamālā 17, Ahmedabad 1919.

Aśokavatīkathā
by Candanācārya, Śvetāmbara Jain. Mentioned by Soḍḍhala in his Udayasundarīkathā (

Aśokavanikāṅka
a. act of a Rāmāyaṇa drama like the Āścaryacūḍāmaṇi, popular in Malabar. Cherp 42. Krāṅgāṭ Mana 42.

Aśokaśrī
Bud.
--Kālayamārisādhana. Cordier II. p. 280.
--Piṇḍīkṛtahomavidhi. Cordier II. p. 279.
--Mañjuśrīcaryāmārgavidhi. ibid. p. 280.
--Mañjuśrīsādhana. ibid. p. 279. III. p. 70.
--Vajrabhairavasādhana. Cordier II. p. 280. III. p. 167.

Aśokāvadāna
Bud. Avadānas about Aśoka. Camb. Uni. Bud. p. 110 (Aśokāvadānamālā). [Page434-a. (See also ibid. p. 6). Hpr. III. p. 7. Nanjio 1459. Nepal II. p.. 174. 242 (Kunāla an. Vītaśoka Avadānas). RASB.

. SBL. Nepal p.. 6-16 (Col. Ratnāvadānamālā).

Aśokāvadāna
Bud. by Jayaśrī. AS. p. 244.

Asoḍha
guru of Soḍhala (a. of Guṇasaṅgraha).
